title: Run of the Constant-Fill Machine
statement: Fix a bit $b$, an input word $x$, a natural number $i\le |x|$, and an output word $out$. Starting from the configuration with the machine in its running state, the input head at position $i+1$, no work tapes, and output $out$, after $|x|-i+1$ steps the machine is halted at the right boundary, with output $out$ followed by $|x|-i$ copies of $b$.
replaced: For a fixed bit $b$, an input $x$, a position $i \le |x|$, and a current output word $w$, running the constant-fill machine for $|x| - i + 1$ steps from the configuration scanning position $i$ with output $w$ halts at the right boundary with output $w$ extended by $|x| - i$ copies of $b$.
